qsm-secrets pipe.description: Run a consumer with the key's value on its stdin; the command follows a -- separator, so this verb is reached from a shell, not from the noun

args.name: key
args.description: the stored key name

args.name: folder
args.description: the rbw folder to read (default: qsm)

qsm-secrets env.description: Run a consumer with the key's value in one environment variable; the command follows a -- separator, so this verb is reached from a shell, not from the noun

args.name: pair
args.description: <key>=<ENVVAR>

args.name: folder
args.description: the rbw folder to read (default: qsm)

qsm-secrets set.description: Store a new key; the value is typed into the vault's own prompt and is never an argument or stdin

args.name: key
args.description: the key name to store under

args.name: folder
args.description: the rbw folder to write (default: qsm)

qsm-secrets has.description: Report whether the key is stored: ok when it is, missing when it is not; never a value

args.name: key
args.description: the stored key name

args.name: folder
args.description: the rbw folder to read (default: qsm)

qsm-secrets list.description: Print the key names this wrapper stored in the namespace; never a value

args.name: folder
args.description: the rbw folder to read (default: qsm)

qsm-secrets inspect.description: Print name, username and folder for every entry in the namespace, whoever stored it; never a value

args.name: folder
args.description: the rbw folder to read (default: qsm)

qsm-secrets rm.description: Remove a stored key; reports missing rather than a silent success when it was not stored

args.name: key
args.description: the stored key name

args.name: folder
args.description: the rbw folder to write (default: qsm)

qsm-secrets get.description: Write the value to file descriptor 3, which the caller opens; refuses when it is closed

args.name: key
args.description: the stored key name

args.name: folder
args.description: the rbw folder to read (default: qsm)

qsm-secrets capture.description: Read a prompt piped on stdin, store each secret in it (a known token shape, or a 32-character token of high entropy) in the active backend under a generated id, and print the text with each value replaced by {{secret:<id>}} and, for a long secret, its last four characters

qsm-secrets mask.description: Read text piped on stdin and print it with each named id's stored value replaced by its {{secret:<id>}} placeholder

args.name: id
args.description: a captured id whose value is masked

qsm-secrets scrub.description: Replace every captured value that is still in a transcript with its placeholder, by rewriting the file atomically; never prints a value

args.name: transcript
args.description: a transcript path, or a session id, found as <id>.jsonl under ~/.claude/projects

args.name: detach
args.description: start the scrub in a detached process and return at once

qsm-secrets render.description: Write a template with each {{secret:<id>}} or {{secret:<namespace>/<key>}} filled in to a file only this session's user can read, under XDG_RUNTIME_DIR, and print its path

args.name: template
args.description: the template file's path

args.name: out
args.description: the rendered file's name inside the session directory

args.name: session
args.description: the session id (default: CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID)

qsm-secrets clean.description: Remove the session's directory with every file rendered into it

args.name: session
args.description: the session id (default: CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID)

qsm-secrets doctor.description: Probe every prerequisite the other verbs depend on and name the fix for each failed check

args.name: folder
args.description: the rbw folder to probe (default: qsm)
